fact: MWiML published an open CC BY 4.0 repository of NLP datasets for Pulaar, Soninke and Hassaniya Arabic (e.g. 991 Pulaar-French pairs, a 708-entry Soninke-French dictionary, 100 Hassaniya stories), with the Wolof folder still empty.

Sahara Media reports the Mauritanian digital transformation ministry and the World Bank agreed to mobilise additional funds for data infrastructure and data sharing to widen AI use and develop intelligent systems under WARDIP.

An arXiv report submitted 13 September 2026 introduces Enemray, a Hassaniya-centred language model trained on a newly assembled Hassaniya and Mauritanian corpus and evaluated against open and proprietary models; the abstract states no release.
